$schema_note: Authored reconstruction programme. Structure records remain the scene source of truth; tools/generate_recommended_infill.py checks its generated parcel against this ledger.
confidence: moderate aggregate; interpretive per anonymous instance

south.character: Commercial core along South Water and Lake, then mixed blocks with density falling rapidly southward.

west.character: Older irregular fabric at Wolf Point approaches: cabins, taverns, yards, work and river storage.

north.character: Scattered development around Kinzie properties and crossings, with substantial open ground.

fort.character: Ten principal roofs in the custom Fort Dearborn compound; stockade and props are outside this roof count.

B.description: mixed town blocks with rear outbuildings

D.description: sparse or open plat; few or no roofs

protected_existing_policy: Every existing record is retained. Named or better-documented geometry may replace an anonymous recommended roof only by an explicit later substitution, never by addition to the 665 target.
reconciliation_note: Existing structure records include bridges, stockade segments, yards and multi-roof compounds; record count is not roof count. A physical-roof reconciliation precedes the final 665-instance release.

programme_phases.purpose: Map every committed structure record to zero, one, or several physical roofs without deleting evidence.

A dry-terrain initial North Division recipe; the remaining 90 North roofs wait for unified terrain, hydrology, collision, flora, streets and map coverage to local N +760 m.
Verify settlement/terrain extents before expanding west and north; do not confuse the enlarged plat with occupied footprint.
